name: rarity-ig-publish
title_zh: 成品帖一键上真实 Instagram
tagline_zh: 设计稿和文案都齐了，就差最后一步。它把压缩图挂到你的 GitHub 仓库。
tagline_en: Design and caption done—this ships them live. Hosts compressed slides on your GitHub repo, then hits the Graph.
desc_en: Publishes a finished Rarity Instagram post (photo or carousel) LIVE to @rarity.agency via the Instagram Graph API. STEP 4 of the Rarity IG pipeline, consuming the rendered art from rarity-ig-designer and the caption from rarity-ig-captions. Hosts the compressed slides on the project's own GitHub repo (raw.githubusercontent.com) since the Graph API only accepts a public image_url, never a direct up
why_zh: Graph API 只收公开 image_url，它用 raw.githubusercontent.c…
why_en: Graph API demands a public image_url; it uses raw.githubusercontent.com as a zero-cost host, closing the pipeline without.
limit_zh: 只发单图或轮播，不支持视频/Reels；必须已有 rarity-ig-designer 产物和 rarity-ig-c…
limit_en: Photo/carousel only, no video/Reels. Needs rarity-ig-designer output and rarity-ig-captions text. GitHub repo must be public with write token. Posts.
title_en: Publish finished IG posts live via Graph API, GitHub-hosted
